guideTitle: 7 Best Mini Dustpan and Brush Sets in 2026
metaTitle: Best Mini Dustpan and Brush Sets in 2026
metaDescription: Seven mini dustpan and brush sets compared on pan size, lip type, nesting storage and multi-pack value for desks, counters, cars and small spills.
introParagraphs: A mini dustpan and brush set is the tool you reach for when a full broom would be absurd. Crumbs on a counter, eraser dust on a desk, sand in a car footwell, spilled rice in a drawer: these are small messes that need a small pan, a soft brush and a quick sweep. The best mini sets are easy to hold, easy to store and honest about how little they can carry.

The category splits cleanly into single sets and multi-packs. The OXO Compact, Pine-Sol, NACENA and MR.SIGA are single sets with distinct designs, while the Amazon Basics, Lamoutor and SOUJOY listings give you two, three or six sets in one purchase. A multi-pack means a set in every room, in the car and in the garage, and that changes how often you actually use it.

We evaluated seven distinct mini sets based on product specs and buyer feedback on each listing. We left out an animal cage cleaner set and a duplicate color of a set already included, since neither added a different design. When a dimension or material is not on the listing, we say to check the product page. Think about where the set will live before choosing, because a tool kept within reach gets used and a tool buried in a cabinet does not.

products.name: OXO Good Grips Compact Dustpan and Brush Set
products.description:
The OXO Compact is the most refined mini set here. The slim shape is built for convenient storage, and the brush snaps into the dustpan so it stores with the bristles covered. The dustpan has a soft rubber lip that conforms to surfaces for efficient cleaning.

The listing mentions car cleaning, tents and crumb brushing as uses, which gives a sense of the range of jobs. Storing the bristles covered is more important than it sounds, because bristles that stay pressed against a surface bend and stop sweeping well. The tradeoff is that the listing does not state dimensions or material in the excerpt, so check the product page for pan size.

In daily use it is the set most people will reach for first. Compared with the Pine-Sol, it gives you a rubber lip and covered bristles, while the Pine-Sol is the cheaper nesting design. Compared with the Amazon Basics 2-pack, it is a single set, so you pay for refinement rather than quantity.
products.bestFor: One dependable mini set for the kitchen drawer.
pros: Soft rubber lip conforms to surfaces
Brush snaps in with bristles covered
Suited to cars, tents and counters
cons: Dimensions are not in the excerpt

products.name: Pine-Sol Mini Dustpan and Brush Set
products.description:
The Pine-Sol set uses a nesting snap-on design, so the brush and pan lock together into one compact piece. The listing says the pan is sturdy for durability and the brush has a whisk shape, and it is aimed at tables, desks, camping, RVs and college dorms.

The nesting design is the key feature, because a mini set that stays together is more likely to be found when you need it. It is the cheapest in this group by listing position, which makes it a sensible choice for a car, an RV or a second drawer. The tradeoff is that the excerpt does not mention a rubber lip, so check the product page for lip details before relying on it for fine dust.

It is a simple, practical choice for casual use. Compared with the OXO, it costs less but gives fewer details about the lip. Compared with the SOUJOY 6-pack, it is a single set with a recognizable brand.
products.bestFor: A low-cost set for a car, RV or dorm.
pros: Whisk-shaped brush for desks and tables
Listed for camping, RV and dorm use
Lowest cost position in this group

products.name: NACENA Small Dust Pan and Brush Set
products.description:
The NACENA mini set has an ultra-thin flat design. The brush uses flat plastic bristles that the listing says slide into narrow areas, and the dustpan is sealed along its edges with flexible silicone strips that fit tightly to the ground so debris does not spill out.

Hanging holes on both the broom and the dustpan let you hang them on a wall or a cabinet door. A thin brush is the feature that separates this set from rounder whisk brooms, because it can reach into gaps such as between a stove and a counter. The tradeoff is that flat bristles pick up less volume than a fuller whisk, so large piles take more strokes.

It works for keyboards, windowsills and tight spots. Compared with the OXO, it reaches narrower gaps but covers less area per stroke. Compared with the Lamoutor 3-pack, it is a single set with a better seal.
pros: Ultra-thin flat brush slides into narrow areas
Silicone pan edge seals against surfaces
cons: Flat bristles move less volume per stroke

products.name: Amazon Basics Small Portable Mini Dustpan and Brush Set, Pack of 2
products.description:
The Amazon Basics pack includes two mini dustpan and brush sets. The listing says they are made from polypropylene and PET plastic, with a flush rubber lip on the dustpan edge and an angled brush with flexible bristles that collects fine dust and dirt from corners and hard-to-reach areas.

Two sets let you keep one in the kitchen and one in a bathroom or car. The rubber lip is the feature that gives it an advantage over many cheaper sets. The tradeoff is size, because mini sets are slow on larger spills, and the listing does not state dimensions in the excerpt.

It is a balanced choice for most households. Compared with the Lamoutor 3-pack, you get two sets instead of three, but the listing highlights a rubber lip. Compared with the OXO, you get a spare but less polished storage design.
products.bestFor: A set in two rooms with a rubber lip.
pros: Flush rubber lip on the pan
cons: Dimensions are not listed in the excerpt
Storage design is less refined than OXO

products.name: Lamoutor 3 Pack Mini Hand Broom and Dustpan Set
products.description:
The Lamoutor listing is a 3-pack of mini hand brooms and dustpans in mixed colors. The pan measures 7.5 by 5 inches, the plastic is PP, and the bristles are described as soft and flexible, which makes sweeping easier.

The brush snaps into the dustpan so each set is easy to carry and store. The listing mentions desks, cars and animal areas, so it is meant for light cleanup. The tradeoff is that the excerpt does not mention a rubber lip, so check the product page, and a stated 7.5 inch width limits how much each pan can hold.

It is a good fit for a household that wants many sets. Compared with the Amazon Basics 2-pack, you get three sets but no stated rubber lip. Compared with the SOUJOY 6-pack, it has fewer sets with a smaller pan.
products.bestFor: Giving each room or a car its own set.
pros: Stated pan size of 7.5 x 5 inches

products.name: SOUJOY 6 Pack Small Dustpan and Brush Set

specList.label: Size
specList.value: 8 inches L x 6.3 inches W each

products.description:
The SOUJOY listing is a 6-pack, with each set measuring 8 inches long by 6.3 inches wide. The material is PP, described as BPA-free, lightweight and smooth, and the brush is described as soft so it does not hurt surfaces.

The brush handle snaps directly onto the dustpan handle and locks in place for compact storage, and hanging holes allow wall or hook storage. Six sets is the most in this group, so it suits classrooms, offices, rentals or gifting. The tradeoff is that you get a lot of basic plastic rather than one refined tool, and the excerpt does not mention a rubber lip.

It is a good pick when quantity matters. Compared with the Lamoutor, it gives twice the sets and a slightly larger stated size. Compared with the Pine-Sol, you get six nesting sets instead of one.

products.name: MR.SIGA Mini Dustpan and Brush Set, Bamboo Handle
products.description:
The MR.SIGA mini set has a natural bamboo handle, which the listing describes as more environmentally friendly and comfortable to hold. The brush is made of dense, durable bristles that will not scratch the cleaning surface, and the dustpan has a soft rubber lip that lies flat.

The handle snaps into the dustpan for storage, and the listing suggests kitchens, offices, bathrooms and garages. The bamboo handle gives it a more decorative look than plastic sets, but wood and moisture do not always mix, so check the product page for care. The listing also gives a measurement, but the excerpt is cut off, so check the exact size before ordering.

It is the mini set that looks best on a hook. Compared with the OXO, it trades a plastic grip for bamboo. Compared with the NACENA, it has a rubber lip instead of a silicone edge.
products.bestFor: A mini set that looks good on display.
cons: Exact size is not in the excerpt

buyingCriteria.explanation: A mini pan holds less, so size sets the limit on what you can sweep. The Lamoutor pan is 7.5 by 5 inches and each SOUJOY set is 8 inches by 6.3 inches, which gives it a little more room. The OXO, Pine-Sol and NACENA listings do not give dimensions in the excerpt. If you sweep more than crumbs, pick the larger stated pan.

The lip is what actually picks up fine dust. The OXO Compact and MR.SIGA list soft rubber lips, the Amazon Basics lists a flush rubber lip, and the NACENA uses silicone edges. A rigid lip leaves a line of dust. If the listing does not describe the lip, check the product page.

Mini brushes come as whisk shapes or flat shapes. The Pine-Sol uses a whisk shape for desks and tables, while the NACENA uses flat plastic bristles that slide into narrow areas. The Amazon Basics brush is angled for corners. Choose flat for gaps and whisk for open surfaces.

A set that snaps together is easier to keep. The OXO stores with bristles covered, the Pine-Sol nests, the SOUJOY snap locks and the Lamoutor snaps into the pan. Covered bristles last longer than bristles pressed against a drawer. Hanging holes, on the NACENA and SOUJOY, help in small kitchens. Keep expectations realistic: a mini pan handles a teaspoon or two of debris per scoop, so for a larger spill it is faster to pick up the bulk by hand and use the set for the dust that remains.

A multi-pack changes where you keep the tool. The Amazon Basics has two sets, the Lamoutor three and the SOUJOY six. More sets means one in each room, but also more plastic. Choose a single refined set if you want one tool to last. A set that hangs on a hook by the stove or desk tends to get used more often than one stored in a drawer, which is why hanging holes on the NACENA and SOUJOY are worth noticing.

Most mini sets are PP plastic, as on the Lamoutor and SOUJOY, while the Amazon Basics uses PP and PET. The MR.SIGA uses a bamboo handle for a warmer look. A handle you can grip comfortably matters for quick, frequent use. Check the product page for grip details. Wipe the pan lip with a damp cloth now and then, since sticky residue can lift the edge off the surface and leave a thin line of dust behind.

howWeEvaluated.description: We compared lip types and pan sizes, since fine dust is the whole point. The OXO, MR.SIGA and Amazon Basics list rubber lips, and the NACENA uses silicone edges. We relied on listing specs and buyer feedback themes.

howWeEvaluated.title: Brush design
howWeEvaluated.description: We looked at bristle shape and flexibility. The NACENA flat bristles reach gaps, the Pine-Sol whisk suits flat surfaces, and the MR.SIGA lists dense bristles. We flagged missing details.

howWeEvaluated.title: Storage design
howWeEvaluated.description: Nesting and hanging features matter for small tools. The OXO stores with bristles covered, the SOUJOY locks, and the NACENA hangs. We weighed these for everyday practicality.

howWeEvaluated.title: Pack value
howWeEvaluated.description: We compared one, two, three and six set options. The Amazon Basics has two, the Lamoutor three and the SOUJOY six. We noted that quantity trades off against refinement.

howWeEvaluated.title: Lineup positioning
howWeEvaluated.description: OXO leads on refinement, NACENA on narrow gaps, Pine-Sol on cost, MR.SIGA on looks, and the multi-packs on quantity. We evaluated each against its likely job.

faq.q: What is the best mini dustpan and brush set?
faq.a: The OXO Good Grips Compact is the best overall because of its soft rubber lip and covered bristle storage. The NACENA is the best for narrow gaps. The Pine-Sol suits budget and RV use. Pick by the mess you clean most. Check the product page for the latest details before you buy.

faq.q: How big is a mini dustpan?
faq.a: Sizes vary. The Lamoutor pan is 7.5 by 5 inches and the SOUJOY sets are 8 by 6.3 inches. Other listings do not state sizes in the excerpt. Check the product page before buying. Check the product page for the latest details before you buy.

Yes, a soft rubber lip lies flat and picks up fine dust. The OXO, MR.SIGA and Amazon Basics list rubber lips. The NACENA uses silicone edges for a similar effect. A rigid lip leaves a visible line. Check the product page for the latest details before you buy.

A multi-pack makes sense if you want a set in several places. The Amazon Basics has two, the Lamoutor three and the SOUJOY six. A single better set suits someone who wants one reliable tool. Think about how many rooms you clean. Check the product page for the latest details before you buy.

Bristles pressed against a surface bend and stop sweeping well. The OXO stores with bristles covered when the brush snaps in. Nesting sets like the Pine-Sol also protect them. Hanging sets keep bristles free.

faq.q: Can I use these on a car?
faq.a: Several listings mention cars and tents, including the OXO Compact. Mini sets handle sand, crumbs and dust. They are slow on bigger debris. Keep a set in the car so you use it.

faq.q: How do I clean the brush?
faq.a: Tap the brush against a hard edge and pull stubborn hair by hand. Rinse plastic sets with mild soap and let them dry before storing. Bamboo handles, like the MR.SIGA, should not soak. Check the product page for care.
